parameters.content:
## 1. Understand what you said
Clean-up in four visible steps, then a **follow-up** check (answers to Stella's own questions), then **12 rule families**
(instant, each node shows whether it fired), then the **local LLM router** (gemma4:e4b, JSON, few-shot) with a
**second opinion** from qwen3:8b if the first answer is not a valid intent. Everything meets at **Intent decided**.
**Dry run** returns the decision without acting: the test suite in `voice/tests` uses it.

## Music
Plays on laptop (Brave, YouTube Music) when the laptop is online, otherwise on Stella. One node per control so each command is visible.

## Timers
Set, cancel, time left. Timers live in the hands key-value store so a cancel reaches a timer that is already waiting.

## Reminders
Clock times ("at 6", "quarter past five", "7 tomorrow") or durations ("in 20 minutes"). Spoken and posted to Discord when due.

## Weather
Open-Meteo for London, no key. Four formatters, then coat and umbrella advice tuned for someone who feels the cold.

## Clock
Time and date, London time.

## Claude on laptop
No yes/no. Detects "I'll be back" style phrases (unattended: Claude asks on Discord via the Claude Remote flow), maps spoken project names to folders, expands vague briefs, checks laptop is online, then launches a visible terminal.

## Research
Hands the topic to the Stella Research flow (SearXNG + local models); the cited brief lands on Discord.

## Homelab
Single questions (is X online, storage left, is a service running) are answered live by Stella's hands (/host: tailscale, Server gateway, laptop for nas). Otherwise the Homelab Monitor summary.

## Deadlines
Same list as the Deadline Countdown flow, copied in at build time. Filter, Sort and Limit nodes, then spoken.

## Notes
Voice notes go to Discord through the Notify Relay flow.

## Message me
"Send me that on Discord".

## Mail
Read-only Gmail over IMAP with an app password (stella-voice/mailcheck.py): unread in the last day, or from/about searches. Headers only.

## Calendar
Read-only calendar (stella-voice/calcheck.py): today, tomorrow, next, this week.

## Laptop control
Opens websites, apps, folders and project folders on laptop, or searches; locks the screen. The laptop agent only accepts allow-listed job types.

## Routines
Good night, good morning, I'm leaving, I'm back: each a short sequence of real actions.
## Help
## Repeat
## Cancel

## Chat
Anything else: the router's own short answer, or qwen3:8b.

## 3. Reply, remember, log, then wait
**Finalise** gives every branch the same reply shape with timing. **Speech clean-up** makes it Kokoro-friendly.
**Reply** answers at once; in parallel the reply is remembered (*say that again*) and **logged** for the dashboard.
Timers and reminders then **Wait** and **Ring**, after checking the timer wasn't cancelled meanwhile.
